summary.intent: Land a stack of four related PRs (#473-#476) for release-notes/changelog improvements, verify they work together, and keep the work moving after the user said to continue.
summary.outcome: Combined-tree testing found a one-line semantic conflict between #473 and #474. After all four PRs merged without that fix, main failed to compile its tests and the Release workflow failed. A fix branch (fix/changelog-style-literal) was committed and pushed with a PR link attempted; the fix passes local verification.

repo: Each PR in the stack passed CI alone, but #473 (added a test building a ChangelogInput literal) and #474 (added a required `style` field) fail to compile together: `missing field style`.
Repo verification is run via a verify.sh covering pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and two workflow contract scripts.
The Release workflow on main fails when main's tests do not compile; it failed on the last two merges.
PR checklist template now includes a Docs line requiring updates to spec, ARCHITECTURE.md, architecture pages, docs/config.md and docs/errors.md where applicable.
Merge-order notes for the release-notes work live in .claude/plans/PLAN-release-notes.md.

code.finding: The `plan_with_summary` test builds a ChangelogInput literal that needs `style: Default::default(),` once the `style` field exists; this is the missing line that broke main.

workflow: Octopus-merging open PR heads in a scratch worktree surfaces semantic conflicts that per-PR CI and clean textual merges miss.
Recording a known fix in a plan file does not prevent it from being skipped at merge time; the fix should be applied to the PR before merge or a stacked PR should be gated.
After a batch of merges, verify main itself in a fresh detached worktree and check CI run status on main.
Required struct fields with a Default-style fallback are a hazard when parallel PRs add literals of that struct.

friction: Main was broken after #474 merged following #473 without the predicted one-line fix being applied.
The Release workflow failed on the last two merges to main.
Local verify and the real-run script had to be adapted per worktree path (sed on the target dir).
open_items: Open and merge the fix PR from fix/changelog-style-literal to restore main (PR number lookup result not shown).
Confirm the Release workflow passes on main after the fix.
Labels and the preview path rule were deferred until #473 and #475 merged.
A real GitHub release and real registry publish are still not exercised; the publish table comes from the offline plan.
Consider a safeguard (e.g. merge queue or CI on merge result) to catch cross-PR semantic conflicts.
